grapple.def: The Strand grappling hook grenade (also available as Silkstrike's grenade input) that pulls you forward; grappling a Tangle refunds it.
grapple.q: Weave a grappling hook, and quickly pull yourself forward.

grapplemelee.def: A melee performed during or just after a grapple that deals area damage and unravels; it counts as both a grenade and a melee ability.
grapplemelee.q: Grapple Melee counts as both a Grenade and Melee Ability.

perchedthreadling.def: A Threadling waiting on you instead of attacking; it is sent out when you deal damage or deployed by your class ability with Weaver's Call.
perchedthreadling.q: Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets.

bannerofwar.def: A Titan buff raised by melee, finisher or sword kills that pulses healing to nearby allies and boosts melee and sword damage; kills nearby strengthen it.
bannerofwar.q: raise a Banner of War that pulses with energy, periodically healing nearby allies and increasing melee and Sword damage

weaverstrance.def: A Warlock buff from consuming a Shackle Grenade with Mindspun Invocation; final blows while it is active cause suspending detonations.
weaverstrance.q: Hold to consume your Shackle Grenade and activate Weaver's Trance. Final blows while Weaver's Trance is active create a suspending detonation.

specterdecoy.def: A Strand decoy left by your class ability that draws enemy fire, then detonates and releases Threadlings.
specterdecoy.q: Activating your class ability leaves behind a decoy woven from [Strand] Strand matter that draws the attention of nearby combatants.

whirlingtangle.def: A seeking mass of Strand fibers created when a Tangle is destroyed with Whirling Maelstrom; it damages targets and fires unraveling projectiles on kills.
whirlingtangle.q: Destroying a Tangle will weave a violent, writhing mass of [Strand] Strand fibers.

sword.def: Sword weapons; some pieces trigger on sword kills or boost sword damage.
sword.q: Defeat a target with a melee attack, finisher, or Sword to raise a Banner of War
